noAccess.title: Inbox
noAccess.body: You need the right to see deals to use the inbox.

inbox.threadDisconnected: {address} shows the mail synced so far. New mail is not fetched and nothing can be sent from it until it is reconnected.

toast.archivedLocal: Archived here · {provider} is not updated while the mailbox is disconnected
toast.lead: Lead created from thread · email stays linked

ai.offBody: The summary, readiness to buy and action items are written by Claude once the AI connection is set up. Nothing is generated or guessed until then.
ai.requested: Summary requested — it appears here once Claude has written it.
ai.failed: The summary could not be written. Try again.
ai.ready: Summarise this thread: Claude writes the summary, readiness to buy and action items on request.
ai.noRight: Summaries are asked for by staff with the AI right.

group.noViews: No saved views of people yet.
group.selected: {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} selected in Contacts

summary.excluded: {n} flagged — hover a name for the reason

group.pickTemplate: Choose a template to see the email.
group.notConnected: Group email is sent from your own mailbox, one by one, and none of your mailboxes is connected.

messaging.linkedinBody: Listed beside the inbox. Its scope is an open point (LEA-06) — conversations will link to leads and contacts the same way once defined.
messaging.linkedinOff: Left out until its scope is defined
messaging.waOff: No WhatsApp Business provider is chosen yet
messaging.waEmptyBody: WhatsApp needs a WhatsApp Business provider, and none is chosen yet. Once one is connected, conversations, approved templates and quick replies appear here, and each conversation links to a lead or contact.

calls.title: Call log — logged as activities
calls.noProvider: No telephony provider is connected · the call goes through your phone's calling app and is logged here
calls.willLinkNone: Not linked to a contact — no match for the number.

setup.teamSub: Team inbox · {n, plural, one {# user reads and answers} other {# users read and answer}}
setup.reconnectNote: Reconnecting needs the {provider} sign-in, which is not configured yet. The mail synced so far stays with its records.
setup.oauthMissing: The Gmail and Microsoft OAuth client is not configured
setup.disconnected: Mailbox disconnected · synced mail stays with its records
setup.addBody: Connecting a mailbox needs the Gmail or Microsoft OAuth client, which is not configured. Exchange Online connects through Microsoft 365.
setup.dropboxBody: Mail sent or forwarded here is stored and linked to the matching person and their open deal once the inbound domain is configured. Each deal can get its own address the same way.
setup.addonsBody: Gmail side panel and browser extension — view and add contacts, deals, notes and activities without leaving the mailbox.
setup.tracking: Open and click tracking: {mode} (setting) · real-time notifications to the sender

vis.private: Private to the owner and members
